intro.title: Session Timeout Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a custom React hook called `useSessionTimeout` that automatically logs a user out after a period of inactivity. You will learn how to use the `useState` and `useEffect` hooks to manage state and side effects, and how to handle browser events like mouse movements and key presses. The main technologies involved are React hooks and JavaScript event listeners. By the end, you'll have a reusable hook that can help secure applications by managing user sessions.
intro.usecase: Session timeout hooks are essential in secure applications where user inactivity could compromise data. In banking dashboards, they automatically log users out after periods of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access to financial information. E-commerce checkout forms use them to expire sessions and clear cart data when users abandon the process. Admin panels implement these hooks to protect sensitive configuration interfaces from being left open on shared computers. Developers add these hooks to comply with security standards while maintaining user experience through clear timeout warnings.
